faq.a: In May, the Mediterranean off Marbella averages 18-21°C, climbing to 22°C by the last week. Early May can feel brisk (18-19°C), while late May is pleasantly warm for swimming. A wetsuit top is optional for snorkelling; most swimmers adapt quickly.

faq.q: What are the best days for a boat rental in May 2031?
faq.a: Historically, Tuesday through Thursday offer the calmest seas and lightest winds (10-15 knots). Weekends see more boat traffic and occasional afternoon Levante gusts. For May 2031, aim for 13-15 May or 20-22 May (neap tides) for the flattest water.

faq.q: Does May have rain in Marbella?
faq.a: May is one of the driest months in Marbella, with only 2-4 rainy days on average. Showers, if any, are brief and usually pass by midday. The risk of a full-day washout is very low – less than 5% based on 10-year data.

faq.q: What is the best time of day for a charter in May?

faq.q: How does May 2031 weather compare to June?
faq.a: May is slightly cooler (air temps 22-26°C vs 26-30°C in June) and less crowded. Sea temps are 2-3°C cooler. May offers better visibility and lighter winds on average. June brings more consistent heat but also more afternoon breeze. Both are excellent months for a boat rental.

faq.a: Light layers: a t-shirt, shorts, and a windproof jacket or fleece for morning breezes. Swimwear under clothes. Sunscreen (SPF 50+), sunglasses, and a hat are essential. Non-slip shoes or barefoot on deck. Towels provided on request.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental weather May 2031 trip? You’re in for a treat. May is one of the best months to charter a boat on the Costa del Sol: warm sunshine, calm seas, and fewer crowds than summer. This guide covers sea temperatures, wind patterns, and the best days to go – so you can book with confidence.

Sea Temperature in May 2031

The Mediterranean off Marbella warms steadily through May. Early May sees 18-19°C; by the last week it reaches 21-22°C. For swimming, late May is ideal – most guests find 21°C comfortable without a wetsuit. Snorkelling visibility is excellent, often 15-20m. If you’re sensitive to cold, a thin wetsuit top helps.

Wind Patterns and Best Days

May winds average 10-15 knots. The Levante (easterly) is most common, bringing light chop in the afternoon. Mornings are flat calm. For the smoothest ride, book a Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – weekends see more boat traffic and occasional stronger gusts. Neap tides around 13-15 May and 20-22 May 2031 produce the flattest seas.

Sunshine and Rain

May delivers 10-11 hours of sunshine daily. Rain is rare: only 2-4 days per month, usually brief afternoon showers. Cloud cover is minimal, though afternoon cumulus can build over La Concha. The risk of a full-day washout is under 5%.

Best Time of Day to Charter

Morning departures (10:00) give you calm seas, a relaxed cruise, and lunch at anchor. Afternoon charters (14:00-21:00) offer warmer swimming and sunset views. Most guests prefer 7-hour charters (10:00-17:00). For a shorter trip, 4-hour afternoon slots (14:00-18:00) are popular.

Which Boats Are Best for May?

For small groups, the Marbella boat rental fleet includes the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) – perfect for 9-11 guests. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 minimum 4h) includes a jet ski. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. See our full fleet page for options.

Where to Go in May

Head east to Cala del Faro or Cabopino for sheltered coves. West to Estepona or Sotogrande for longer cruises. The Golden Mile coastline offers stunning views of La Concha. Your skipper will adjust the route based on wind and sea conditions.

What to Pack

  • Light layers: t-shirt, shorts, windproof jacket
  • Swimwear and towel
  • Sunscreen SPF 50+, sunglasses, hat
  • Non-slip shoes or barefoot
  • Camera for dolphin sightings
